description_en: Creates a recording plan based on a time template
description_zh: 调用该接口，根据时间模板创建录像计划
name: CreateRecordPlan

parameters.help_en:
The name of the recording plan.

The name must be fewer than 48 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and the following special characters: hyphens (-), underscores (_), at signs (@), periods (.), and colons (:)
parameters.help_zh:
录像计划名称。

名称长度小于48个字符，可以包含英文字母、数字和特殊字符：短划线（-）、下划线（_）、at（@）、英文句号（.）、英文冒号（:）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the time template associated with the recording plan. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107888.html to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 录像计划对应的时间模板ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107888.html查询
parameters.name: template_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）

Data.description_en: The ID of the recording plan

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
